accepted_summary.model_score_note: Current SR215-TR-2026-11-06-v1 experimental inputs; full 139-residue construct. All 2,000 accepted Phenix/MolProbity prepared queries have 1,113 H and one ring proton per His; HD1/HE2 tautomer varies by model and site. Descriptive model-type summaries retain native reporting precision.
accepted_summary.panel_preparation_note: These prediction-only panels preserve accepted Phenix/MolProbity preparations. Comparisons to uploaded-state medoids span distinct His preparation profiles (prediction one ring proton versus uploaded HD1+HE2 at residues 43, 134–139); differences cannot isolate conformation.
method_notes: Each clustering fit includes exactly the original 1,000 AFS3 + 1,000 BioEmu2 models. The first three fits and six sampled selections are preserved; the fourth clustering fit and its two selections were completed on this exact cohort.
Both UMAP KNN and HDBSCAN views include PCA/UMAP/t-SNE and full 139-residue original-coordinate representatives. The fourth fit has no newly computed Bonsai tree.

All 99 representative entries have native bidirectional full 139-residue average-length-normalized TM to the original 260 state medoids MODEL 45/40/42. The 6,000 prediction-to-medoid comparisons are reused by exact source hashes.
TM state certification uses 15–72 for all/5–95 and 32–47 for both discontinuous clustering subsets. These cores differ from clustering subsets and full 139-residue RPF/TM scope.

One MCMC50 and one DISCO50 per supported state/subset. MCMC uses four chains, 10,000 proposals, 1,000 burn-in, alpha 0.5, tau equal to the original 2,000-model energy IQR, and the chain 0 final subset. Search is bounded and does not prove unique biological states.
Native 50-conformer ensemble RPF uses legacy midrange inter-proton distances, not mean individual-model scores. Member CSV preserves standalone and ensemble-context scores separately.
Double Recall: 24 panel-to-medoid, four MCMC-to-DISCO, three exactly reused medoid baselines. Both legacy-v1 directions and literal QR-record multiplicities are retained; no normalized ratio.
